training.sample_selection: first 2,000 series in file order (deterministic head selection from the processed panel)

leakage_controls: lags and rolling windows shift(1) before rolling
recursive inference feeds predictions back, never validation actuals
calendar features (weekday, month, SNAP, events) are known in advance
postprocess scales fitted on a window the inner model never trained on

postprocess.formula: final[id, day] = scale[id] x level[id] x shape[id, day]; level = mean of the last level_window observed days, shape = raw / series mean, scale = leak-free fit

fitted_on.note: cross-fitted: inner model never trains on its fitting window; the window itself precedes validation

assumptions: future sell prices equal the last observed price unless supplied
future SNAP/event calendar known (M5 calendar is fully observed)
